meta.name: ulw-loop
meta.description: Goal-like loop that uses ultrawork mode to decompose work into systematic, evidence-bound steps.

copy.tagline: 将工作分解为系统化的证据驱动步骤
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要将复杂任务拆解为可执行的步骤
copy.tagline_en: Decompose work into systematic, evidence-driven steps
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to break down complex tasks into actionable steps

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会使用“超工作模式”将复杂目标分解为系统化的、有证据约束的步骤，并持续执行直到完成。它会自动管理任务状态、记录证据，并协调子代理完成代码编辑、测试等工作。
howto.when: 当用户提到“ulw-loop”、“ulw”、持久目标执行、证据驱动工作、手动QA或检查点式长期交付时触发。

say.text: 启动 ulw-loop，帮我分解并执行这个项目目标。
say.note: Claude 会读取工作流文件并开始执行。

say.text: 使用 ulw 模式，将任务拆解为有证据的步骤。
say.note: Claude 会进入超工作循环。

say.text: 开始一个持久目标执行，需要手动QA检查点。
say.note: Claude 会按照工作流进行分阶段执行。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude uses 'ultrawork mode' to decompose complex goals into systematic, evidence-bound steps and executes them persistently. It manages goal state, records evidence, and coordinates subagents for code edits, tests, etc.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user mentions 'ulw-loop', 'ulw', durable goal execution, evidence-led work, manual QA, or checkpointed long-running delivery.

say_en.text: Start ulw-loop and decompose this project goal for me.
say_en.note: Claude reads the workflow file and begins execution.

say_en.text: Use ulw mode to break the task into evidence-bound steps.
Begin a durable goal execution with manual QA checkpoints.
say_en.note: Claude follows the workflow for phased execution.
